bear_assumptions: 2027 revenue reaches USD 1.85 billion at 2.5x EV/revenue, with USD 1.05 billion residual net cash and 202 million diluted shares; growth slows, gross-margin conversion disappoints, annual cash burn persists, and dilution continues.
base_assumptions: 2027 revenue reaches USD 2.05 billion at 3.5x EV/revenue, with USD 1.10 billion residual net cash and 198 million diluted shares; backlog converts, gross and operating margins improve gradually, but investment keeps free cash flow weak through 2027.
bull_assumptions: 2027 revenue reaches USD 2.25 billion at 5.0x EV/revenue, with USD 1.15 billion residual net cash and 195 million diluted shares; organic growth stays near 20%, program scale expands margins toward a durable terminal level, cash burn abates, and major new dilution is avoided.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a refreshed scenario set clears expected-return, base-upside, bear-payoff and margin-of-safety gates at a fresh price, an accepted relationship is established, and funded backlog converts into higher GAAP margin and cash flow without material dilution; downgrade if organic growth slows, program execution weakens, cash use persists, acquisitions impair returns, or further dilution erodes per-share value.
